title: Twelve Monkeys Tropika Iced Shorfill 100ml E-Liquid
description: Tropika Iced by Twelve Monkeys is a refreshing blend of exotic tropical fruits, perfectly balanced with a crisp menthol exhale. Bursting with layers of juicy, sun-ripened fruits, this blend delivers a bold, smooth inhale, while a cooling menthol undertone adds a revitalising finish. Designed with a high-VG 70VG/30PG ratio, Tropika Iced is ideal for Sub-Ohm vape kits and high-powered DTL (direct-to-lung) devices, producing dense vapour clouds and delivering full-bodied flavour. Supplied in a 100ml shortfill bottle with space for two 10ml nicotine shots, this e-liquid allows vapers to customise their nicotine strength. If you prefer this flavour without the cooling sensation, the original un-iced version is also available right here at Vapestore. Twelve Monkeys is an award-winning Canadian e-liquid brand known for its mastery of fruit-inspired blends. With a commitment to high-quality ingredients and complex flavour profiles, their e-liquids offer a premium vaping experience.
